name: voice-playback-diagnostics
title: Voice playback recovery and failure diagnostics
description: Preserve compact voice UI; add failure-only inline hints, foreground no-progress handling, safe Sentry diagnostics and lifecycle regression tests.
creator: cline
notes: Implementation and local checks completed; not committed or deployed. Actual Android/iOS audio, production ingestion and 48h P95 remain post-release verification.

measurement.source: Prior incident Sentry and Railway evidence is single-request evidence, not page P95; precise per-OS scope/release baseline unavailable.
measurement.window: Incident: 2026-11-20 01:00-02:10 Asia/Shanghai; post-release verification: each OS over a new 48h release window.

mobile_performance.notes: Both page baselines null because no valid scoped aggregate is available. No APIs changed or added, so API metrics are not applicable. Keep per-OS 4000ms page objective and compare existing telemetry after release; no fixed-sample local gate.

integration_points: Existing frontend Sentry client sendSentryLog and SDK withScope/captureMessage
Existing voice API client HTTP error logs and Railway HTTP terminal logs remain unchanged
failure_paths: Play rejected or synchronously thrown; media errors; visible no-progress timeout; preload error; deduplicated error/rejection; explicit retry recovery
Pause/takeover/hidden/disposal invalidate timers and callbacks; monitoring throw cannot change playback; no generation or server writes
logging_integration.correlation: Existing Sentry account/release/device/trace context, no new identity fields. Existing API request/trace IDs correlate server generation separately; playback logs do not claim server evidence.
logging_integration.redaction: Finite reason/stage and numeric/boolean media state only. No source URL, raw error/message, content, audio/message/session IDs, credentials or initData.
logging_integration.alerting: No new alert policy; grouped warning at most once per reason/minute. Logs once per attempt phase; exceptions isolated, no telemetry retry.
verification: Focused lifecycle regression tests including privacy and monitoring failure
Frontend full tests, typecheck, lint, build and complexity/import checks; real Android/iOS playback and release P95 remain manual post-release checks

review.basis: Explicit user implementation request; repository planning gates and design.md reviewed before start.
